summary: Record finished merge-group CI runs as evidence notes in a new Evidence observe workflow

replay.detail: Runtime claims and replay behavior are unchanged.

schema.detail: No table, schema version or claim registration changes; the records use the existing v1 evidence format.

rules.detail: Checkpoint and admission rule versions are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Installed st and st2 binaries are unchanged. The new workflow only reads finished runs and writes refs/notes/evidence/*; it skips no CI job.

downtime.detail: No daemon interruption or restart is required.

manual.detail: Operators must register runners with the evidence-ci label and install the observer configuration (see the operator handoff) before the workflow can run; without them its jobs stay queued and nothing else changes.

recovery.detail: Deleting the workflow stops production; published refs/notes/evidence/* refs are inert data.
